title: Anthropic's Rust Migration: What the Verifier Could Not Catch
description: Anthropic's Rust migration passed 98% of tests in April while a quarter of production inputs matched. What its verifiers caught, and what took an engineer.
og_headline: Anthropic's Rust Migration: Matched Outputs, Rejected Fix
og_alt: Anthropic's Rust Migration: Matched Outputs, Rejected Fix. An agent's fix passed the verifier by copying a tool description; an engineer rejected it because the target architecture required calling the service.

reciprocal.desc: Anthropic's Python-to-Rust port of its Messages API: a fix passed the output verifier and an engineer still rejected it on architecture.
Another migration scored by parity with the original: in Anthropic's Rust migration an agent matched outputs by copying a description instead of calling the service.
What Anthropic's Rust migration shows about turning repeated review corrections into checks, and which migration rules a forbid-only check cannot express.
